purpose: Track both storage compatibility and official capabilities that replace, narrow, or unblock this project.

capabilities.summary: Official Codex lists, searches, and reads normal threads with runtime state and pagination. Local commands remain for offline, legacy, and damaged-state inspection.
Rename, archive, unarchive, resume, fork, send, steer, interrupt, goals, and normal task control belong to official Codex.

Official Codex hard-deletes persisted threads, spawned descendants, rollout files, and associated state. This project retains independent verification, recoverable trash, legacy cleanup, and failure recovery.
No public official contract was found for previewable recoverable trash, restore conflict checks, or operation-journal recovery.
Official delete does not publish an independent retained-surface receipt covering legacy indexes, snapshots, global state, and failed or delayed derived-state cleanup.
Official controls can enable or disable memory use and generation per task, and can reset all local memories.
No supported per-entry or per-session view/edit/delete contract exists for final consolidated memory. Generated memory files are inspectable but are not the primary control surface.

Official thread delete removes thread-linked Stage 1 memory state and schedules reconsolidation, but final derived text may remain until that background work succeeds or may remain when supported by other threads.

Official App Server has experimental turn and item pagination. This project keeps its existing process-local bounded event-page bookmark but does not expand it into a cross-host handoff or resource protocol without evidence.
Official Codex can import supported external-agent sessions and configuration, reducing the value of a broad Amp exploration project.
Official version-bound App Server schemas make a small isolated compatibility and delete-behavior harness practical.
